title: Fourier average bound above a set-size threshold
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in[0,1]$ with $\delta\le\tfrac12$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube whose values lie in $[-1,1]$. If $t$ is a natural number and $S$ is a set of coordinates with $t<|S|$, then the expected absolute Fourier coefficient indexed by $S\cap K$, where $K$ is sampled with the subset weights at parameter $1-\delta$, is at most $\sqrt{(1-\delta)^t}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a set of coordinates with $t<|S|$
